lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
recommendations-dashboard: 589 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 262 B, generated by rollup 197 B, generated by typescript 79 B.
recommendations-main: 68 B beyond the first copy, generated by @nextcloud/vite-config 68 B.
58,364 B in 507 pieces of 5 files have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (74 packages, 243 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in build is left without something that loads it.
